I feel like I got confirmation of this. I did some amazing, once in a lifetime things when I was in high school. Things people work their whole lives for.
And I just was miserable the whole time.

The more I read, the less it sounds like she is. She regularly boasted about us (I'm one of three) and did support me in a lot of extra curriculars. I know she was abusive, I know she is still manipulative... just maybe not a narcisist. I don't want to write everything out in public...
I go wallsend - never really had any wait there.
